gap: No result ChatGPT got that I could read states how many 8-hour workdays each full-size low-profile board lasts on one charge by its maker's rating: about 12 for the Keychron K5 Max (95 h), 46 for the K5 Ultra 8K (370 h), 12.5 for the Lofree Flow Lite 2 100 (100 h), and 125 lights-off but only 3 to 9 lights-on for the NuPhy Air100 V3.
standout_why: I could fully read only purchase.fyi among the rival pages: it gives no battery hours for any board and names the K5 Max only as an honorable mention. The cited RTINGS pages (best low-profile, K5 Max review) returned navigation only, and Technobezz returned HTTP 403, so I could not check whether they state battery hours; the score assumes they do not. ChatGPT's two answers mention battery for no pick.
decides: On rated battery it backs ChatGPT's second-run pick, the K5 Ultra 8K, over the K5 Max: 3.9 times the rated hours for $15.75 more at Keychron's from-prices today. It does not help our Lofree Flow Lite 2 100: 100 rated hours is level with the K5 Max and far behind the Ultra and the NuPhy, at a higher price than both Keychrons, so Lofree cannot place on battery. Two cautions: the makers' hour figures are not like-for-like (Keychron's conditions were not in the text I read), and all Lofree figures come from KitGuru because lofree.co returned HTTP 429 on every attempt today.
